mapper.select: /* CastFltPsgMapper.retrieveFltPsgHourList */ SELECT SUBSTR(A.PREDC_HM, 1, 2) AS HOUR, COUNT(*) AS FLT_CNT, SUM(A.RSVT_BDPSG_CNT - A.RSVT_TRNS_BDPSG_CNT) AS PSG_CNT FROM GOOWN.TN_GO_GD_DATA A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.GD_SE_YMD = #{ymd} -- T1 은 제1여객터미널(P01) + 탑승동(P02), T2 는 제2여객터미널(P03) AND A.TMNL_ID IN (#{item}) -- 유효 운항편 필터 8종 AND A.ARR_DEP_SE_CD = 'D' AND A.CSHR_STTS_CD != 'SL' AND A.PSG_CGO_SE_CD = 'Y' AND A.ARCFT_USE_SE_CD IN ('0', '1') AND A.GD_FLT_PRPS_CD IN ('00', '05') AND A.FRY_YN NOT IN ('Y') AND A.DOM_INTL_SE_CD NOT IN ('D') AND A.DLY_RSN_CD NOT IN ('2', '3') AND A.PREDC_HM IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SUBSTR(A.PREDC_HM, 1, 2) ORDER BY HOUR
mapper.insert: /* CastFltPsgMapper.insertUserFltPsg */ INSERT INTO PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_FLT_PSG ( SMLT_ID, TMNL_ID, ADJ_TYPE_CD, ADJ_RT, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_RGTR_IP_ADDR, FRST_REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{smltId}, #{fcltTmnlId}, #{adjTypeCd}, #{adjRate}, #{loginUserId}, #{loginIpAddr}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
